name: Extreme Ironing
shortDesc: Iron your clothes in the most dangerous and remote locations possible. Mountains, underwater, while skydiving - the more extreme, the better!

name: Competitive Duck Herding
shortDesc: Guide ducks through obstacle courses using only your voice and hand gestures. It's like sheepdog trials, but quackier!

name: Underwater Basket Weaving
shortDesc: The legendary hobby is real! Weave beautiful baskets while submerged in water. Requires excellent breath control and dexterity.

name: Cheese Rolling Racing
shortDesc: Chase a 9-pound wheel of cheese down a steep hill at breakneck speeds. First one to catch it wins (or survives)!

name: Competitive Toe Wrestling
shortDesc: Like arm wrestling, but with your toes! Lock feet with your opponent and try to pin their foot for three seconds.

name: Mooing Contests
shortDesc: Compete to produce the most realistic cow mooing sounds. Judges rate on authenticity, volume, and emotional depth.

name: Soap Carving Sculptures
shortDesc: Transform ordinary bars of soap into intricate works of art. It's like ice sculpting, but you can wash your hands with your mistakes!

name: Professional Noodling
shortDesc: Catch catfish with your bare hands by sticking them into murky underwater holes. What could go wrong?

name: Backwards Running
shortDesc: Run marathons and races while facing backwards. Improves balance, coordination, and your ability to look silly!

name: Beard Baubles Decorating
shortDesc: Decorate your majestic beard with ornaments, lights, and tinsel. Turn your facial hair into a festive masterpiece!

name: Competitive Paper Plane Throwing
shortDesc: Engineer and throw paper planes for distance, accuracy, and flight time. Aerodynamics meets origami!

name: Worm Charming
shortDesc: Coax earthworms out of the ground using vibrations, music, or dancing. The person with the most worms wins!

name: Extreme Pogo Sticking
shortDesc: Perform tricks, jumps, and stunts on high-performance pogo sticks. Bounce your way to glory!

name: Vintage Lunchbox Collecting
shortDesc: Amass a collection of retro metal lunchboxes from the '60s, '70s, and '80s. Nostalgia you can carry!

name: Cardboard Tube Fighting
shortDesc: Medieval combat with wrapping paper tubes! Safe, silly, and surprisingly strategic.

name: Gurning Championships
shortDesc: Make the ugliest, most distorted face possible through a horse collar. It's an actual British tradition!

name: Beetle Racing
shortDesc: Train and race beetles in tiny racetracks. Place your bets on your favorite arthropod athlete!

name: Tattooing Fruit
shortDesc: Practice your tattoo artistry on oranges, bananas, and other produce. It's vegan and your mistakes are edible!

name: Shoebox Diorama Building
shortDesc: Create entire miniature worlds inside shoeboxes. From historical battles to fantasy landscapes!

name: Competitive Bed Racing
shortDesc: Attach wheels to beds and race them down streets. One person rides while the team pushes. Surprisingly fast!

name: Moss Graffiti Art
shortDesc: Create living street art by painting walls with a moss and yogurt mixture. Watch your art grow!

name: Ostrich Racing Jockey
shortDesc: Ride giant birds at speeds up to 40 mph. Like horse racing, but with more personality and pecking!

name: Geocaching Extreme Edition
shortDesc: Hunt for hidden treasures using GPS coordinates in the most remote and challenging locations on Earth.

name: Potato Battery Engineering
shortDesc: Power electronic devices using only potatoes and basic chemistry. How many spuds to charge your phone?

name: Extreme Sitting
shortDesc: Sit in chairs placed in dangerous or unusual locations. On cliff edges, in trees, underwater - creativity required!

name: Vintage Typewriter Repair
shortDesc: Restore and maintain mechanical typewriters from the early 1900s. Clacking keys, no batteries required!

name: Mushroom Foraging Competitions
shortDesc: Hunt for edible mushrooms in forests. Knowledge, speed, and not dying are key to winning!

name: Stick Insect Breeding
shortDesc: Raise colonies of these camouflage masters. Watch them pretend to be twigs all day long!

name: Rubber Duck Debugging
shortDesc: Explain your code problems to a rubber duck. Surprisingly effective troubleshooting method!

name: Train Horn Recording
shortDesc: Travel the world recording the unique horn sounds of different locomotives. Build the ultimate train horn library!

name: Competitive Hair Freezing
shortDesc: Dip your head in hot springs in freezing weather and sculpt your freezing hair into wild shapes!

name: Ant Farm Architecture
shortDesc: Design elaborate tunnel systems for your ant colonies. Watch your tiny workers build underground cities!

name: Spoon Bending Mind Control
shortDesc: Attempt to bend spoons using only your mind (or clever hand tricks). Uri Geller would be proud!

name: Bog Snorkeling Championships
shortDesc: Swim through muddy bog trenches wearing snorkels and flippers. The murkier, the better!

name: Bonsai Tree Cultivation
shortDesc: Grow and prune miniature trees for decades. Patience is required, but your tiny forest will be magnificent!

name: Cassette Tape Mixtape Making
shortDesc: Curate perfect 90-minute playlists on analog cassettes. Rewind and fast-forward your way to nostalgia!

name: Pumpkin Chucking Engineering
shortDesc: Build catapults and air cannons to launch pumpkins as far as possible. Physics meets produce destruction!

name: Silent Disco Dancing
shortDesc: Dance to music only you can hear through wireless headphones. To observers, you're just weirdly grooving in silence!

name: Matchstick Architecture
shortDesc: Build intricate models of famous buildings using only matchsticks and glue. Thousands of tiny sticks, infinite patience!

name: Hermit Crab Shell Decorating
shortDesc: Paint and bedazzle shells for hermit crabs to move into. Give your crabby friend a stylish home upgrade!

name: Fossil Hunting Expeditions
shortDesc: Scour ancient rock formations for prehistoric treasures. Every pebble could be a 100-million-year-old discovery!

name: Kinetic Sand Sculpting
shortDesc: Mold mesmerizing sculptures from satisfying moldable sand that never dries out. ASMR meets art!

name: Pigeon Racing Training
shortDesc: Train homing pigeons to race across hundreds of miles. GPS on wings, but way more impressive!

name: Traffic Cone Collection
shortDesc: Amass cones from different cities, countries, and eras. The holy grail: a vintage 1960s cone!

name: Yodeling Competitions
shortDesc: Master the art of Alpine yodeling! Rapid pitch changes echo through mountain valleys beautifully.

name: Ferrofluid Magnetic Art
shortDesc: Manipulate liquid that responds to magnets to create otherworldly spiky sculptures. Science meets magic!

name: Competitive Napping
shortDesc: Race to fall asleep the fastest in noisy environments. Snoring is judged as a skill, not a flaw!

name: Lock Picking Sport
shortDesc: Master the art of opening locks without keys. Completely legal when you own the locks!

name: Shipping Container Home Design
shortDesc: Transform industrial cargo containers into livable tiny homes. Upcycling meets architecture!

name: Chess Boxing Championships
shortDesc: Alternate between rounds of chess and boxing. Checkmate with your brain, knockout with your fists!

name: Vintage Radio Restoration
shortDesc: Bring old tube radios back to life. That warm analog sound beats digital any day!

name: Bottle Cap Mosaics
shortDesc: Create colorful artwork from thousands of collected bottle caps. One person's trash is your masterpiece!

name: Urban Beekeeping
shortDesc: Maintain bee colonies on rooftops in the middle of cities. Fresh honey from the concrete jungle!

name: Competitive Ice Fishing
shortDesc: Drill holes in frozen lakes and compete to catch the most fish. Patience in sub-zero temperatures required!

name: Rubik's Cube Speed Solving
shortDesc: Solve the classic puzzle in under 5 seconds. Your fingers move faster than people can blink!

name: Sandcastle Engineering
shortDesc: Build architectural wonders from sand and water. Cathedrals, castles, and cities that disappear with the tide!

name: Parkour Free Running
shortDesc: Turn the urban landscape into your playground. Vault, climb, and flip through city obstacles!

name: Origami Crane Folding Marathon
shortDesc: Fold 1000 paper cranes to make a wish come true. Japanese tradition meets repetitive motion disorder!

name: Duct Tape Fashion Design
shortDesc: Create wearable clothes, accessories, and art entirely from duct tape. Surprisingly durable and waterproof!

name: Soap Box Derby Racing
shortDesc: Build gravity-powered cars and race them downhill. No engines, just wheels, gravity, and courage!

name: Competitive Eating Contests
shortDesc: Consume massive quantities of food faster than anyone else. Your stomach capacity is your superpower!

name: Crystal Growing Chemistry
shortDesc: Grow stunning crystals at home using simple chemistry. Watch geometric perfection form before your eyes!

name: Historical Reenactment Battles
shortDesc: Dress in period costume and recreate famous battles. Live history, but with fewer casualties!

name: Kombucha Brewing Experiments
shortDesc: Ferment tea with SCOBY (symbiotic culture of bacteria and yeast). Create fizzy probiotic drinks that taste amazing!

name: Miniature Railway Building
shortDesc: Construct elaborate model train layouts with tiny towns, mountains, and working signals. Choo choo!

name: Zorbing Ball Rolling
shortDesc: Climb inside a giant inflatable ball and roll down hills. Like being a hamster, but more extreme!

name: Tarantula Keeping
shortDesc: Raise these fuzzy eight-legged pets. They're actually quite docile and need surprisingly little maintenance!

name: Concrete Canoe Racing
shortDesc: Build canoes entirely from concrete and race them on water. Buoyancy is optional, skill is mandatory!

name: Escape Room Designing
shortDesc: Create elaborate puzzle rooms to trap (and eventually release) your friends. Sadistic creativity required!

name: Medieval Calligraphy
shortDesc: Master the art of beautiful handwriting using traditional quills and ink. Make grocery lists look like royal decrees!

name: Pickle Making Science
shortDesc: Ferment cucumbers and other vegetables into tangy preserved delights. Your brine recipe is your secret weapon!

name: Unicycle Commuting
shortDesc: Ditch the bike and ride to work on one wheel. Balance is everything, embarrassment is guaranteed!

name: Pinball Machine Restoration
shortDesc: Bring vintage arcade pinball machines back to their flashing, dinging glory. Tilt responsibly!

name: Moth Taxonomy Collection
shortDesc: Identify and catalog different moth species. They're butterflies' goth cousins and just as beautiful!

name: Soap Making Alchemy
shortDesc: Mix lye and oils to create handcrafted soaps. Chemistry that leaves you smelling fantastic!

name: Fire Poi Spinning
shortDesc: Swing flaming balls on chains in mesmerizing patterns. Dance with danger and look incredibly cool doing it!

name: Mushroom Growing Cultivation
shortDesc: Grow gourmet mushrooms at home in logs or bags. Oyster, shiitake, and lion's mane right in your closet!

name: Kendama Ball Catching
shortDesc: Master this Japanese wooden skill toy by catching the ball in various cups. Harder than it looks!

name: License Plate Collecting
shortDesc: Gather plates from every state, country, and era. The ultimate road trip souvenir collection!

name: Extreme Couponing
shortDesc: Turn grocery shopping into a game where you walk out with carts full of stuff for pennies. Math skills required!

name: Bottle Ship Building
shortDesc: Construct detailed sailing ships inside bottles using tweezers and patience. How'd they get in there?

name: Stick Fighting Martial Arts
shortDesc: Learn Escrima or Kali Filipino stick fighting. Two sticks, endless possibilities for whacking!

name: Storm Chasing Photography
shortDesc: Chase tornadoes and supercells across the plains for that perfect shot. Adrenaline and excellent insurance required!

name: Typewriter Poetry
shortDesc: Compose poems on vintage typewriters in public spaces. Offer instant custom poems to strangers!

name: Magnet Fishing Adventures
shortDesc: Drop powerful magnets into waterways and pull up metal treasures (and trash). Urban archaeology with ropes!

name: Slacklining Balance
shortDesc: Walk on bouncy webbing strung between trees. Like tightrope walking, but bouncier and closer to the ground!

name: Terrarium Ecosystem Building
shortDesc: Create self-sustaining miniature worlds in glass containers. Tiny gardens that water themselves!

name: Yo-Yo Trick Mastery
shortDesc: Learn hundreds of complex yo-yo tricks. From basic sleepers to advanced string manipulations!

name: Cheese Making Artisan
shortDesc: Transform milk into delicious homemade cheeses. Mozzarella, cheddar, brie - all from your kitchen!

name: Mechanical Keyboard Building
shortDesc: Custom build keyboards with different switches, keycaps, and layouts. The clickiest, clackiest hobby ever!

name: Balloon Animal Twisting
shortDesc: Twist balloons into dogs, swords, hats, and elaborate sculptures. Bring joy (and potential pops) everywhere!

name: Chainmail Armor Making
shortDesc: Link thousands of metal rings into medieval armor. Tedious, but you'll be ready for the next crusade!

name: Competitive Whistling
shortDesc: Whistle complex melodies and compete internationally. Your puckered lips are your instrument!

name: Robot Combat Building
shortDesc: Build remote-controlled robots to fight in arenas. BattleBots but with your own destructive creation!

name: Hydroponic Gardening
shortDesc: Grow plants without soil using nutrient-rich water. Fresh vegetables from your apartment!

name: Knife Throwing Accuracy
shortDesc: Stick blades into targets from increasing distances. Dangerous, thrilling, and surprisingly therapeutic!

name: Clock Repair Horology
shortDesc: Fix and restore antique clocks and watches. Tiny gears, springs, and the satisfaction of keeping time!

name: Scratch Lottery Ticket Strategy
shortDesc: Develop mathematical strategies for scratch-off tickets. Probably won't win millions, but the odds improve!

name: Butterfly Knife Flipping
shortDesc: Perform flashy tricks with balisong knives. Impressive to watch, dangerous to learn!

name: Sourdough Bread Starter Care
shortDesc: Maintain a living yeast culture and bake artisan bread. Your starter is basically a pet that makes toast!
